alpha_counts.note: The PNG is RGB and has no alpha channel; the checkerboard is baked into the pixels.

background_reconstruction.diagnostic_rule: Flood-fill edge-connected pixels whose minimum RGB channel is >= 235 and whose RGB chroma is <= 12.
background_reconstruction.enclosed_detail_rule: After primary-component selection, preserve enclosed holes of at most 64 pixels so intentional light eye/details survive without retaining exterior checker pixels.
background_reconstruction.output_alpha: Binary review mask only; the immutable source is not changed.
background_reconstruction.strong_foreground_rule: Treat a pixel as strong foreground when its minimum RGB channel is < 225 or its RGB chroma is > 18.

a.description: Each complete 265x371 cell, after deterministic baked-background extraction and primary-component cleanup, is reduced directly to 40x56 with nearest-neighbor sampling.

b.description: All primary components use one shared scale, nearest-neighbor sampling, translation-only horizontal centering, and feet alignment to row 55.

candidate_methods.selection_reason: Neither review candidate can restore pixels clipped across the row-3/row-4 source boundary.

identity_guardrail_audit.finding: No weapon, armor, tool, satchel, insignia, Festival symbol, Edenite, species-specific anatomy, or occupation-bearing prop is visible.

failures: Connected reconstructed foreground components touch source-cell boundaries in r3c1, r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r4c1, r4c2, r4c3, r4c4.
The row-4 hair crosses the exact row-3/row-4 boundary; deterministic cropping cannot prove or restore complete up-facing silhouettes.
quality_gate.required_action: Use manual Aseprite correction or replace/regenerate all four up-facing frames with complete transparent headroom, then repeat the audit.

visual_consistency_audit.body_proportions: Consistent enough for review; production approval is blocked by clipping.
visual_consistency_audit.clothing_and_skin_tone: Consistent cream sleeves, moss/olive clothing, brown belt, dark trousers, practical boots, and warm skin tone.
visual_consistency_audit.head_and_hair: Consistent design, but every up-facing crown crosses the row boundary.
visual_consistency_audit.left_right_authorship: Left and right are separately presented and are not simple lighting-reversing mirrors.
visual_consistency_audit.lighting: Apparent upper-left lighting is broadly consistent; live art review remains required.
visual_consistency_audit.up_facing_details: Back-facing construction is apparent and no front facial details are visible.
visual_consistency_audit.walk_poses: Four plausible walking poses appear in every direction; no running pose is apparent.
